extracted.intended_audience: Windows users who want to sign up for and stream Dropout
extracted.subtask_description: Step-by-step guidance for signing up, downloading/using, and streaming the Dropout subscription service on a Windows PC (primarily via web browser). Includes feature notes (trial, pricing, downloads, parental controls) and other-device pointers.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to Sign Up and Download Dropout on Windows
rubrics_metrics.description: Click here to sign up for Dropout. Watch content on the Dropout website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page directs Windows users to sign up via the Dropout signup link and to watch content through the Dropout website (i.e., streaming in a browser rather than a Windows app).

rubrics_metrics.name: Web Browsers
rubrics_metrics.description: Watch content on the Dropout website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied recommendation/requirement that Windows users stream via a web browser to access Dropout content; no separate Windows app/install steps are provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: 3-Day Trial
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dropout offers a 3-day free trial for new subscribers (noted prominently). Users should expect a trial period before being charged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pricing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Base subscription pricing is presented as $5.99+ per month; users should check current pricing and plan details on Dropout's site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discount Code for Annual Subscription
rubrics_metrics.description: Save 20% OFF the annual subscription fee with the code: DROPOUTFULLYEAR
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An advertised promotional code (DROPOUTFULLYEAR) for 20% off annual plans; users may apply this when signing up if still valid.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supported Other Streaming Devices
rubrics_metrics.description: If you have other devices, you can learn how to sign up for and use Dropout on Amazon Fire TV, Apple TV, Google Chromecast, Roku, Android TV, iPhone/iPad, Android Phone/Tablet, Mac, Xbox, Samsung Smart TV, Sony Smart TV, and VIZIO Smart TV.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although this page focuses on Windows, it lists many other supported devices and provides links/pages for device-specific signup/use instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: No Parental Controls
rubrics_metrics.description: There are no parental controls for Dropout.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users should be aware that Dropout does not offer parental control features; the page contrasts this with other services (Prime Video, Apple TV, Disney+, etc.) that do provide parental controls.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offline Downloads
rubrics_metrics.description: Dropout allows you to download certain content for offline viewing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The service supports offline downloads for select content — useful for users who want to watch without an active internet connection. Specifics (which titles, device limitations) are not detailed on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originals and Content Focus
rubrics_metrics.description: Dropout is a subscription video on demand service that primarily focuses on gaming. The content comes from the team behind CollegeHumor. Its longest-running show is the Dungeons & Dragons series “Dimension 20.” Subscribers will also see game shows like “Um, Actually,” “Dirty Laundry,” and “Make Some Noise.” The service also hosts 1,500 classic CollegeHumor videos.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This describes the service's content strengths and specialties, which may inform a user's decision to subscribe; highlights flagship shows and archive content volume.
